description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-18 under road-to-steps-the-skill-cannot-skip AC-1, which repaired dead links in this skill's SKILL.md and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover the PR-opening moment in its explicit and implicit forms ('open a PR', 'ready to merge'), a stacked-PR handover, a targeted sanity-check ask and a German variant. Near-misses use the exclusions this skill's SKILL.md names: processing feedback (receiving-code-review, the sharpest edge) and work that is not yet code-complete, plus doing the review itself (code-review). Counterexamples guard documentation-only changes, which the skill excludes, and a non-code 'request'.

queries.q: the feature is done and tests are green — open a PR for it
ready to merge, get this in front of a reviewer
the second PR in the stack is ready; make it easy for whoever reviewed the parent to pick it up
can you ask Lena to sanity-check just commit a3f9e1, the migration one?
Branch ist fertig, mach bitte einen PR mit sauberer Beschreibung und Testplan
the bot left review comments on my PR — work through them
queries.note: the sharpest edge: same loop, opposite direction — processing feedback → receiving-code-review, which this skill's SKILL.md names

queries.q: review this diff for security problems
queries.note: the user wants the review itself performed, not a review requested → code-review

queries.q: half the tests still fail but let's wrap up the branch — merge it or keep it?
queries.note: not code-complete, which this skill excludes; deciding the branch's fate is finishing-a-development-branch

queries.q: fix the typo in the README
queries.note: documentation-only with no behaviour impact — excluded in this skill's SKILL.md, and nothing asks for review

queries.q: request a quote from the hosting provider for the bigger plan
queries.note: 'request' in a procurement sense, unrelated to code review
